review_candidates.title: Senior Telco Network Engineer — Proxy & GSLB
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Comparable telco network-security roles combine firewall, proxy, load-balancer, and incident-management responsibilities across large-scale environments. Key responsibilities: Design, deploy, administer, and troubleshoot F5 BIG-IP platforms, including LTM, GTM/GSLB, virtual servers, pools, nodes, health monitors, SSL profiles, iRules, and traffic policies. Configure and maintain network security controls, including firewalls, VPNs, NAT, access-control policies, certificates, and high-availabilit
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Senior Telco Network Engineer — Forward & Reverse Proxy (Fortinet/F5) Experience: 10+ years in telecommunications, service-provider or large enterprise network operations Mandatory: Hands-on F5 BIG-IP experience, Forward and Reverse Proxy experience is required for both Fortinet and F5. Mandatory requirements 10+ years of relevant experience in telco, ISP, managed services, data centre, or large enterprise networking. Mandatory hands-on F5 BIG-IP experience, covering LTM and GTM/GSLB, application delivery, SSL offloading, iRules, and traffic-management policies. Preferred requirements Fortinet experience, particularly FortiGate/FortiOS, FortiManager, and FortiAnalyzer; Fortinet NSE or equivalent certification is desirable.
